entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... I think I need to return something? I'm a bit lost with the process.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Gable, and the order was... VF-881-92B. It's for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here, delivered 26 days ago. To make sure I'm on the right track, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, um, preference, I guess? There's nothing wrong with it. I just... I think I **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy** and I just **don't use it** like I thought I would. The website was a little confusing, and now I don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I understand completely. Sometimes a product just doesn't fit into the routine as expected. Let me just pull up our current return policy to check the eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, Sarah, thanks for your patience. I've checked the policy, and you're all set. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh! Really? Are you sure? I thought I read something about it being much shorter, or that I might have to do some kind of **resale** on a marketplace if I waited too long.

Yes, I'm sure. My system confirms that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, as long as they are in original condition. I am emailing you a prepaid return shipping label right now. You should see it in your inbox shortly.
Wow, okay. That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome, Sarah! We want to make sure you're happy. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
